scripts.lint: biome check . && node scripts/text-check.mjs && uv run --project packages/mkdocs ruff check packages/mkdocs docs/hooks
scripts.test: npm test --workspaces --if-present && uv run --project packages/mkdocs pytest packages/mkdocs
scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser --workspaces --if-present && SITE_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8080/ npm run docs && BUILDGUIDE_SITE=../../site npm run test:browser -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/docusaurus && BUILDGUIDE_SITE=../docusaurus/example/build npm run test:browser -w packages/core
scripts.dist: npm run dist --workspaces --if-present && uv build packages/mkdocs
